items.title: Add the 2025-08-01-preview SaaS Protection API
items.summary: Adds a new preview version and changes CloudAccount PATCH, activation, role-assignment, protection-group, company-profile, and storage contracts. The effective REST and generated SDK surfaces remove or require multiple existing fields and replace the custom PATCH request model with the full resource model.

inferenceResults.rationale: The required-property changes are already represented by deterministic REST and downstream candidates; no distinct additional impact is established.
Adding and selecting the new preview version does not by itself establish an additional compatibility issue beyond the concrete contract candidates.
The RoleAssignment requiredness changes are already covered by deterministic REST and downstream candidates; no additional unique candidate is needed.
The removed and renamed CloudAccount properties are already covered by deterministic REST and downstream candidates.
The versioning customization does not negate the observed generated method/model changes, which are already represented by deterministic candidates; it adds no separate unique finding.

intentAssessments.title: CloudAccount PATCH uses a non-recommended resource patch template
intentAssessments.expected: Keep a specific PATCH request model and use ArmCustomPatchAsync<CloudAccount, PatchRequestModel> so the REST and SDK update contract remains intentional and stable.
intentAssessments.actual: CloudAccounts.update changes from the recommended ArmCustomPatchAsync<CloudAccount, CloudAccountUpdate> pattern to ArmResourcePatchAsync<CloudAccount>. The generated SDK facts show the update parameter changes from CloudAccountUpdate to CloudAccount and the dedicated update models disappear.
intentAssessments.rationale: Official ARM operation guidance explicitly states that ArmResourcePatch* is not recommended because its visibility-derived PATCH shape is only honored by the AutoRest emitter and is not replicated in SDK generation. The observed SDK surface change demonstrates that risk and breaks existing clients.
intentAssessments.gap: Official ARM operation guidance explicitly states that ArmResourcePatch* is not recommended because its visibility-derived PATCH shape is only honored by the AutoRest emitter and is not replicated in SDK generation. The observed SDK surface change demonstrates that risk and breaks existing clients.
